content: No, that is not true. The 13th AHV pension is a one-time bonus payment made to all recipients of Swiss Old Age and Survivors' Insurance (AHV) pensions. It is **not** reserved exclusively for people with an invalidity pension. Anyone who receives an AHV pension is eligible and does not need to apply separately; the payment is issued automatically by the competent AHV fund upon reaching the eligible age (typically after the first year of receiving an AHV pension).
